_comment: EN / CHIP_PU RC delay catalog. tau = R*C; EN crosses Vih at ~1.2*tau, must be > rail ramp time. Synthesized 2026-05-17 from Espressif HW Design Guidelines (Schematic Checklist - Power Scheme) for ESP32 / S2 / S3 / C3 / 8266.

esp32.rationale: Espressif ESP32 HW Design Guidelines - Schematic Checklist: CHIP_PU 10k pull-up + 1uF to GND. Tau=10ms gives 5x margin over typical 1-2ms rail ramp.

esp32-s2.rationale: ESP32-S2 HW Design Guidelines: identical to ESP32 (10k + 1uF).

esp32-s3.rationale: ESP32-S3 HW Design Guidelines Schematic Checklist: 10k + 1uF on CHIP_PU.

esp32-c3.rationale: ESP32-C3 HW Design Guidelines: identical RC.

esp8266.rationale: ESP8266 + WROOM-02: CH_PD 10k pull-up + 100nF to GND (POR faster than ESP32, smaller cap).

_generic.applies_when: MCU has active-high enable on a rail that ramps >1ms (battery, solar, slow PMIC LDO, shared rail with large bulk cap)
_generic.rationale: tau = R*C = 10k * 1uF = 10ms; EN crosses ~0.7*VDD at ~1.2*tau = 12ms, comfortable for any 1-5ms rail ramp. Use C=4.7uF for supercap/battery rails.
